purpose: Exploratory qualitative sample for MIRA v5 history taking; not clinical validation
selection: First three consecutively numbered consultations on day 1 in PriMock57; no outcome-based selection
attribution: Alex Papadopoulos Korfiatis, Francesco Moramarco, Radmila Sarac, Aleksandar Savkov (2022), PriMock57. Dataset babylonhealth/primock57.
transform: Merged doctor and patient TextGrid intervals by start time, retained overlapping intervals and transcription uncertainty tags; no audio listened to. IDs are local interval IDs, not original dialogue turns.

additional_sample.article: Conversas invisíveis: assuntos falados, mas não ouvidos em consultas ginecológicas
additional_sample.authors: Stela Nazareth Meneghel; Daniela Negraes Pinheiro Andrade; Lilian Zielke Hesler
additional_sample.selection: Purposive contrasting excerpts: hesitant disclosure, unclarified complaint, sexual pain, psychosocial disclosure; not representative prevalence sample
additional_sample.raw_reproduction: Not copied; paraphrases and source line locators in analysis

contextual_schema.use: CMAS schema consulted as design reference; no additional full MediTOD encounter counted

limitations: Three simulated consultations and four excerpts from one real consultation study; not seven independent complete cases.
Single AI qualitative reviewer; not blinded medical adjudication.
Transcription errors and ambiguous speaker timing remain possible.
No new MIRA inference, no model or prompt changes, no financial ledger changes.
